title: Wrangler-seam probe drives two concurrent increments against the DO through env.CELL and one WebSocket upgrade through env.HUB, both routed via the DO facade so the sole-reader guarantee holds
asA: reviewer verifying the platform-cloudflare-durable-objects v1.0.0 blueprint under a real workerd runtime
iWant: the wrangler-seam probe to spawn wrangler dev on the cf-platform fixture, issue two concurrent POST /cell/<id>/increment requests against a route in src/index.mjs that reaches env.CELL through the DO facade (createDoFacade({env}).cellFetch), and open one WebSocket upgrade against /hub/<id>/connect that reaches env.HUB through the facade (createDoFacade({env}).hubFetch), asserting per-instance serialisation on the increments and one broadcast frame on the WebSocket
soThat: the shipped DO facade + SingleCellObject + HubObject code path is proven against workerd, not only against the in-memory storage driver and the fake websocket state that the six in-process probes drive

acceptanceCriteria.description: The wrangler-seam probe, when the fixture has been prepared with `pnpm install --ignore-workspace` so the wrangler devDependency is on the tree, spawns `wrangler dev --local --port 0` from the cf-platform fixture, waits bounded 45 seconds for the CLI to bind, then (a) issues two concurrent POST /cell/<id>/increment requests against a fetch route in src/index.mjs that calls createDoFacade({env, eventSink}).cellFetch(<id>, request), asserting the two responses observe per-instance serialisation (sorted counters == [1, 2], sorted witnesses == [0, 1], each request read the other's write) and (b) opens one WebSocket upgrade against /hub/<id>/connect via createDoFacade({env, eventSink}).hubFetch(<id>, request), asserting one broadcast frame arrives on connect with payload 'hello-from-hub'. The probe kills wrangler cleanly on exit. Warn semantics per section 3.1 pass-with-skip: if wrangler is not installed or fails to bind within the cap, the probe returns aggregateVerdict warn (never fail); a handler thrown at the workerd boundary is a genuine fail. The additional result on the same probe run covers AC-33108-1 by grepping the fixture wrangler.toml for the two [[durable_objects.bindings]] pairs and the [[migrations]] tag/new_classes pair; the grep result is deterministic and does not require wrangler.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the cf-platform fixture with the wrangler devDependency installed and the shipped DO classes exported from src/index.mjs
acceptanceCriteria.then: wrangler dev binds; two concurrent increments through env.CELL observe per-instance serialisation; one WebSocket upgrade through env.HUB receives a broadcast frame; the wrangler.toml grep confirms both binding pairs and the migrations tag/new_classes; wrangler exits cleanly
